name: boldform-lite
description: Build tooling for the BoldForm Lite WordPress plugin (dev-only; not part of the shipped plugin).
author: Themewant

scripts.build: wp-scripts plugin-zip && { zip -qd boldform-lite.zip boldform-lite/package.json boldform-lite/README.md || true; } && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && unzip -qo boldform-lite.zip -d build && mv -f boldform-lite.zip build/boldform-lite-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.release: [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'Working tree is not clean - commit or stash before releasing.'; exit 1; } && npm run build
